name: Daylio Backup Import
changes: Use the rules below, Merge entries into daily notes and Save rules now show how to get Pro, with a Sponsor on GitHub button, when you select them. Nothing turns on or saves until Pro is on.
tip: With Pro, turn on "Merge entries into daily notes" to add a line for each entry under a heading in its daily note.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Daylio Backup Import is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for moving your journal into Obsidian with it.
